mapper.sql: SELECT e.id, e.branch_id, e.job_scheduler_id, e.commune_id, e.nationality_id, e.gender_id, e.marital_status_id, e.contract_type_id, e.job_type_id, e.code, e.name, e.last_name, e.mother_last_name, e.birth_date, e.phone, e.email, e.address, e.contract_date, e.contract_end_date, e.active, b.id as branch_id, b.name as branch_name, js.id as job_scheduler_id, js.name as job_scheduler_name, co.id as commune_id, co.name as commune_name, cn.id as nationality_id, cn.name as country_name FROM employee e LEFT JOIN branch b ON e.branch_id = b.id LEFT JOIN job_scheduler js ON e.job_scheduler_id = js.id LEFT JOIN commune co ON e.commune_id = co.id LEFT JOIN country cn ON e.nationality_id = cn.id LEFT JOIN company c ON b.company_id = c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (branch_id, job_scheduler_id, commune_id, nationality_id, gender_id, marital_status_id, contract_type_id, job_type_id, code, name, last_name, mother_last_name, birth_date, phone, email, address, contract_date, contract_end_date, active) VALUES (#{branch.id}, #{jobScheduler.id}, #{commune.id}, #{country.id}, #{gender.id}, #{maritalStatus.id}, #{contractType.id}, #{jobType.id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{lastName}, #{motherLastName}, #{birthDate}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{contractDate}, #{contractEndDate}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET branch_id = #{branch.id}, job_scheduler_id = #{jobScheduler.id}, commune_id = #{commune.id}, nationality_id = #{country.id}, gender_id = #{gender.id}, marital_status_id = #{maritalStatus.id}, contract_type_id = #{contractType.id}, job_type_id = #{jobType.id}, code = #{code}, name = #{name}, last_name = #{lastName}, mother_last_name = #{motherLastName}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, address = #{address}, contract_date = #{contractDate}, contract_end_date = #{contractEndDate}, active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
